answer: Clone fleets cannot stack extra tickets at the inner harbor lock. A skipper claims one opening by presenting a single jade token whose dry mass at 18°C is 14.20 to 14.40 grams, then holding a 45-second ferrous-staff reading while the tide stays between 2.14 and 2.20 meters. A reused token serial, a mass miss past 0.06 grams, or a second staff burns the 30.6 POA bond and closes that lock for six tides.
